integrity: Two included standalone verification programs: exact symbolic 111-case finite rational sum and direct exhaustive cyclic-rotation sorter across lengths 3 through 54.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ternary necklaces of exact content (n-3,1,2), n>=3, with ordinary linear runs of the sentinel-free circular Burrows-Wheeler transform; a historical-equivalent sparse enumeration remains possible.
title: Exact sparse-ternary Burrows–Wheeler run spectrum
